greeting: 👋 Hi! I'm the EasyTech Group assistant. Pick a topic or ask your question.
fallback: I didn't quite understand. Here are the topics I can help with:

topics.label: Network & Infrastructure
topics.answer: We design and deploy Cisco network infrastructures (switches, routers, Meraki Wi-Fi) for African organizations. Every project starts with a free network audit.

topics.label: Cybersecurity
topics.answer: As an authorized Fortinet partner, we deploy FortiGate firewalls, endpoint protection (FortiEDR) and security event monitoring (FortiSIEM) tailored to your organization.

topics.label: Microsoft 365 & Windows Server
topics.answer: As an authorized Microsoft reseller, we help you choose the right Microsoft 365 plan, migrate your email and data, and deploy Windows Server in your infrastructure.

topics.label: Countries covered
topics.answer: EasyTech Group operates in 8 African countries: Cameroon, Gabon, Congo-Brazzaville, DRC, Ivory Coast, Senegal, Burkina Faso and Chad.

topics.label: Get a quote
topics.answer: Every project is quoted based on your equipment, number of sites and required services. Contact us for a free quote within 48 hours.

topics.label: Talk to an expert
topics.answer: Our certified engineers (CCNA, CCNP, NSE) are available to answer your technical questions. Get in touch directly.
